Name: Swap Lives - Cover Sam's Shift (Pelican Town Economics)
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Pelican Town Economics[/b][/size]
Ten principles from Mankiw's [i]Principles of Economics[/i], each turned into something you can play in Pelican Town. This version has [b]lesson 2: opportunity cost[/b].

[size=4][b]Cover Sam's shift[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]After you've met Sam, he sends you a letter one Saturday night: band practice is at a crucial point and he'd love someone to cover his JojaMart shift.[/*]
[*]On a Monday or Wednesday morning (before 10:50), talk to Sam and he'll ask if you can cover for him today.[/*]
[*]Say yes and you're sent into JojaMart. A few jobs pop up around the store, each marked with a bouncing [b]![/b]: restock the shelf where a Joja Cola floats, or sweep up the trash on the floor.[/*]
[*]Finish them all and the clock jumps to 4 PM - end of shift. You get paid, and Sam likes you a bit more (he spends the day at home playing guitar).[/*]
[*]Walk out early and the shift doesn't count - no wage.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]The price tag[/b][/size]
When the shift ends, a price tag compares your wage with what your farm would normally have earned in those same hours (from the last 7 days of your income; on a new save it uses a rough estimate since day 1). Was the shift worth it?
[i]"The cost of something is what you give up to get it."[/i]

[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
With Generic Mod Config Menu you can turn the lesson off, change the wage, the number of jobs, energy per job, friendship gained, and whether the price tag shows.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu. English and Chinese.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
鹈鹕镇经济课：把曼昆《经济学原理》的十大原理，一讲一个做成星露谷里能玩的东西。现在有第 2 讲「机会成本」：认识山姆后会收到他的信，周一、周三上午找他，他会请你替他去 Joja 上班；店里冒出几处活（头上有跳动的「！」），全干完时间跳到下午 4 点下班、领工资、山姆加好感，再弹一张价签：工资和这几个小时你的农场本来能挣的钱比一比，这个班值不值。

Manifest.Name: Pelican Town Economics
Manifest.Description: Ten principles of economics you can play in Pelican Town. Lesson 2 - opportunity cost: cover Sam's Monday/Wednesday shift at JojaMart and see what the shift really cost you.
